commands.review_summary:
Raises durable exact-review queue admission from 20/16 to 28/24 across canonical limits, dashboard Worker defaults and wrangler config, README/docs, a focused dashboard-worker test, and CHANGELOG.md.

Reproducibility: not applicable. as a production capacity-tuning PR rather than a deterministic bug report. Source inspection confirms current main still admits 20 global and 16 per-target exact reviews, while the PR body provides live queue/fleet telemetry as operational evidence.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The remaining action is maintainer/operator approval for production admission values and release-owned changelog handling, not a safe automated branch repair.

target.title: improve(queue): raise exact-review admission to 28
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The durable exact-review queue is admission-bound during OpenClaw bursts even while the global worker fleet has spare capacity. On July 6, 2026, the queue held 68 pending OpenClaw items with the oldest waiting about 47 minutes, while the 128-worker fleet was only 57% utilized and reported no recent failures.

## Why This Change Was Made

Raise exact-review admission from 20 to 28 global leases and from 16 to 24 leases per target repository. This preserves four global slots for other repositories and stays below the existing hard ceiling of 32.

The change updates the canonical limits, production Worker configuration, defaults, tests, documentation, and changelog together.

## User Impact

ClawSweeper can drain OpenClaw review bursts faster while retaining reserved capacity for Crabbox, openclaw.ai, CodexBar, and other targets.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/check-active-surface.ts` - passed
- `node scripts/check-limits.ts` - passed
- `tsgo -p tsconfig.dashboard.json` - passed
- `node --test test/dashboard-worker.test.ts` - 55 tests passed
- Focused `oxlint` and `oxfmt --check` - passed
- `git diff --check` - passed
- Autoreview against `origin/main` - clean, no actionable findings
- Live queue: 68 pending, 1 dispatching, 18 leased; oldest pending about 47 minutes
- Live fleet: 73 active Codex jobs, 57% of 128-worker budget, no recent failures

The full local `pnpm run check` could not start because the shared worktree dependency link requires reconciliation. Direct touched-surface checks passed; hosted CI remains the full proof.
